description.value: The Salmo Valley Youth & Community Centre is a non-profit society that saved a former high school from demolition in 2004, converting it into a hub for community programming in the small Kootenay town of Salmo. The centre offers a gymnasium, event rentals, youth drop-ins, workshops, and seasonal festivals, making it a notable gathering point for local and visiting community members. Touring cyclists passing through Salmo may find it a useful community contact point, though cyclist-specific amenities are not advertised.

judgement.verdict_reason: policy: rental/community-programming facility, no walk-in visitor offering

wow_evidence: Converted school offering rentals, youth drop-ins, festivals; KW-PRIVATE; community-facing, not a visitor stop.
blurb: Community centre in a saved former high school in Salmo.
